title: Fire Illusion
paragraphs: “If that’s the case, Gaelion can fly and check it out.”
“Can I ask you to do that?”
“Leave it to me!”
Saying that, Rival took dragon form and flew off. But he came back rather quickly.
“The air currents in the sky are unstable. It’s not a problem for someone of Gaelion’s class, but I saw a sandstorm ahead after flying for a while, so I returned without pushing it.”
“Ugh… a sandstorm, huh… This is my first time in a desert, but it’s just as tough as I expected.”
That’s certainly true. In games, I’ve visited deserts countless times, but experiencing it in reality is much harsher.
“Should we stop for now?”
“Hmm… if it suddenly appeared, I guess there’s no helping it. Maybe we should head back before it gets here.”
“I’ll try again from a higher altitude this time. Naofumi, want to come?”
“I won’t allow it! You’re planning to take Father away with you!”
When I warned him, Rival clicked his tongue. As I suspected, that was exactly his plan.
“There are too many obstacles getting in the way of a romantic night in the desert with Naofumi!”
“Seriously…”
“Nighttime travel does feel kind of romantic, doesn’t it? Look, Naofumi, the stars are beautiful.”
“Naofumi.”
Just then, Itsuki called out to Father.
“Your harem members are getting too excited. Why don’t you just let them blow off some steam already?”
“What kind of comment is that!?”
“For now, I don’t know how big Gaelion and the Filolials can get, but if you want to win, why not let them pull the carriage with skis attached while flying?”
After hearing Ren’s suggestion, Rival thought for a moment and then nodded. Is he seriously going to do it?
“Fine. I’ll pull the carriage while avoiding the sandstorm.”
“Hmm!”
“We will pull the carriage.”
“That’s right!”
“Well, why not just take turns?”
“No way!”
Letting Rival pull the carriage is absolutely out of the question! That’s a job for us Filolials.
“But still…”
Father scratched his head, looking troubled.
“Stop fighting. You know causing trouble for the hero won’t solve anything.”
Just then, the doctor, who had been silent until now, appeared wearing the outfit Big Sister had bought. Are you wearing it too?
“That looks like something a prostitute would wear!”
“Who are you calling a prostitute!?”
Since the doctor already had a Middle Eastern complexion, the outfit suited her perfectly.
“Wow, Rat, that really suits you.”
“Maybe it’s because of her skin, but it looks like it was made for her.”
“Honestly, the white coat she usually wears looks more out of place now.”
“Heroes? Enough already. Right now, we should be figuring out how to make the dragon and Filolials pull the carriage.”
“Well, if it’s come to this, I guess we have no choice. Gaelion should fly back and bring a carriage made for him. Then we can have a race. How about that?”
Ren clapped his hands and pointed at Itsuki.
“I see. On that day, whoever wins gets to pull Naofumi.”
“I won’t lose!”
“Hmm!”
Sakura cracked her knuckles and began stretching, showing her determination. Hmm, not bad. After all, there’s no way Filolials would lose to some dragon.
“It’s a good idea, but am I being treated like a prize here?”
“Now you’re realizing it?”
“Alright, we don’t know how long the journey will take, but how about rewarding the one who wins three days in a row with a kiss from the Shield Hero?”
“Wait, you can’t just make that kind of reward—”
“Hurry up and bring the carriage!”
“Gaelion!?”
“Understood…”
With a flap of his wings, Rival transformed into his dragon form and flew off into the night sky. Such a busy guy. Wait…!
“This is our chance! We should head out now!”
“Isn’t that kind of… unfair?”
“What are you talking about? If we don’t, Father’s kiss will be stolen by Rival!”
“At this rate, it feels more like Sakura’s going to get the kiss…”
“Hmm?”
“Sakura doesn’t seem to understand what it means.”
“Kiss?”
Sakura puckered her lips and leaned toward Father. Oh, she does understand after all.
“Now’s your chance. Naofumi, if you give your first kiss to Sakura, it will deal some damage to Gaelion.”
“Uh… I’m not so sure about that. And I don’t think it’s right to just make my kiss a prize!”
Father looked a bit irritated. Oh… but Father, protecting your innocence from the clutches of that dragon is also an undeniable truth.
“Either way, wouldn’t setting it up as a competition make things move along faster?”
“Sakura, you have to win!”
“I’ll do my best!”
“Is this really okay…?”
“Didn’t you say you wanted to gain a little experience? This is a good chance, so why not offer at least a kiss?”
“Why does this feel… complicated? In games, there are rare moments where things like this happen, but hearing it in real life feels weird…”

Ignoring Father, who seemed slightly exasperated, we continued our journey. As expected of the Desert of Lost paths, known as the Prado Desert, no matter how far we traveled, there was no sign of reaching our destination. By the way, about the race between Rival and Sakura, according to Ren and Itsuki, in terms of the thrill of moving through the desert, riding the sled pulled by the flying Rival felt more exhilarating. But Sakura and the others weren’t backing down!
“This kind of feels like dog sledding in the desert…”

Father’s words left a lasting impression. We traveled like this for about two nights. Something’s strange… We’ve been moving straight ahead, so we should be getting close to leaving the desert, yet the red city we’re heading for never seems to get any closer.
“Um…”
“Could we stop for a moment?”
On the third night, big sister and her friend raised their hands. Following Father’s instructions, Rival and the Filolials paused their nighttime race.
“What’s wrong, Rifana, Raphtalia?”
“I’ve felt it a few times… Raphtalia, you noticed it too?”
“Yeah. We’re being moved somewhere else along the way.”
“So it’s true? There’s a high-density polluted area that’s dulling my senses.”
“Sakura couldn’t tell either.”
“Well, they do call this the Desert of Lost paths, and the Queen and other experts said the same thing.”
“Looks like the power of the heroes won’t help with this one.”
That’s true. It doesn’t seem like the power of the heroes can solve this. I don’t know the exact mechanism, but something is interfering with our movement.
“It’s extremely clever. Even I didn’t notice at first. And the mechanism…”
“Yeah. I’m starting to get a sense of it.”
“What about Sadeena?”
Big sister is quite perceptive and skilled at uncovering hidden things.
“I couldn’t figure it out.”
“The tracks in the sand disappearing so quickly is one thing, but unless you have a strong resistance to illusions, even if you sense something, you won’t realize what’s happening.”
“And even if we know… I don’t think Raphtalia or I could do anything about it.”
“Huh? Rifana, do you know something? I only have a vague idea.”
“Yes. Let’s go a little further.”
“Got it.”
“Understood.”

Hmm, perhaps they’re using some type of illusion related to fire, which her friend specializes in. Mirages, combined with the desert environment, would be a perfect fit. Big sister’s illusions are more about light and darkness. It’s in situations like this where the differences become apparent.
